description.value: Golden City is a Chinese restaurant situated on Fisgard Street in Victoria's historic Chinatown neighbourhood, one of the oldest in Canada. The restaurant offers a broad Cantonese and Szechuan menu spanning soups, chow mein, seafood, and combo plates, with online ordering and fast pickup available. Its location at the edge of downtown makes it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the inner harbour or the surrounding neighbourhoods.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 37m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 40m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (721 Fisgard St, Victoria, BC V8W1R8) and phone (250-590-0226). The site shows an active online ordering system with pickup (15 min), a full menu with vegetarian items (Vegetable Chow Mein, Vegetable Fried Rice, Stir Fried Tofu with Vegetable, Sweet & Sour Tofu, Mushroom dishes) and a legend indicating vegetarian items. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cycling amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Chinese restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and 62 customer reviews. Located in Victoria's Chinatown, a natural stop for touring cyclists in the downtown area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend includes a vegetarian marker; confirmed vegetarian dishes include Vegetable Chow Mein, Vegetable Fried Rice, Stir Fried Tofu with Vegetable, Sweet & Sour Tofu, and multiple mushroom dishes
